title: What Falls Faster in a Vacuum: a Bowling Ball or a Feather?
description:
Remove the air, and the feather stops losing the race.

They fall with the same acceleration in a vacuum.

Gravity gives all freely falling objects the same acceleration; air resistance creates the familiar difference on Earth.

Apollo 15 demonstrated the effect on the Moon using a hammer and falcon feather.
